_comment: kn_brain community feed (services/brain/community.c, doc/backend.md 'Community feed'). Copy to config/community.json (or set brain.community.feed); the brain rereads it when it changes. news: the What's New window and the hub's News tab; events / polls: the menu's Community & Events popup. Dates are UTC ISO 8601. Events past ended_at (else start_date + duration_hours) and polls past ends_at are not served.

gameEvents._comment: A live event (Krunker v10.0.3 config.events + ongoingEvents, doc/v10/events.md, doc/v10/kill-pools.md). From startsAt to endsAt a public round plays it (its eventIndex = id). reveal: ms before startsAt the clients already show it. imgExt: ui/img/events/event_<id>.<imgExt> (png). longDesc: the event popup's text, or a list of lines. noChallenges: the popup says 'playing the event', no View Challenges. rewards.skins: the popup's tiles and the end-of-round reward candidates (with the store's eventReward skins), rewards.weights: rarity weights; rewardChance: percent (100); eligibleMaps: official map indexes it pays on (all). limitedTimeMode: the event's mode (All or Nothing is event 4, Mag Dump 5) is the vote list's first pick. eventObjects: the EVENT prefab's meshes show (always for event 3). Kill pools: every public match draws them once per kill (at most 30) for each signed-in player; killPoolsWeight: the event's share of a draw (percent); killPoolsMode: dilute (shrinks earlier events' shares) or add; killPoolsIcon: ui/img/<icon>.webp on the end screen's Collect button. Only skin contents pay.
